paragraphs.text: 1. THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful;
Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.
2. Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours;
He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.
paragraphs.original: आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्योऽपरिह्वृतो अत्यो न सप्तिः
paragraphs.translit: ā yo vivāya sakhyā sakhibhyo'parihvṛto atyo na saptiḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning,
paragraphs.original: ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसो व्युष्टौ ।
paragraphs.translit: īśe yo viśvasyā devavīterīśe viśvāyuruṣaso vyuṣṭau |

paragraphs.text: Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless.
4. Increasing by his strength. while lauds content him, with easy flight unto the Gods he travels.
paragraphs.original: शूषेभिर्वृधो जुषाणो अर्कैर्देवाँ अच्छा रघुपत्वा जिगाति ।
paragraphs.translit: śūṣebhirvṛdho juṣāṇo arkairdevām̐ acchā raghupatvā jigāti |

paragraphs.text: Agni the cheerful Priest, best Sacrificer, balms with his tongue the Gods with whom he mingles.
paragraphs.original: मन्द्रो होता स जुह्वा यजिष्ठः सम्मिश्लो अग्निरा जिघर्ति देवान्
paragraphs.translit: mandro hotā sa juhvā yajiṣṭhaḥ sammiślo agnirā jigharti devān

paragraphs.text: 5. With songs and adorations bring ye hither Agni who stirs himself at dawn like Indra,
Whom sages laud with hymns as Jatavedas of those who wield the sacrificial ladle.
paragraphs.original: आ यं विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्ति जातवेदसं जुह्वं सहानाम्
paragraphs.translit: ā yaṃ viprāso matibhirgṛṇanti jātavedasaṃ juhvaṃ sahānām

paragraphs.text: 6. In whom all goodly treasures meet together, even as steeds and riders for the booty.
paragraphs.original: सं यस्मिन्विश्वा वसूनि जग्मुर्वाजे नाश्वाः सप्तीवन्त एवैः ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ yasminviśvā vasūni jagmurvāje nāśvāḥ saptīvanta evaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Inclining hither bring us help, O Agni, even assistance most desired by Indra.
paragraphs.original: अस्मे ऊतीरिन्द्रवाततमा अर्वाचीना अग्न आ कृणुष्व
paragraphs.translit: asme ūtīrindravātatamā arvācīnā agna ā kṛṇuṣva

paragraphs.text: 7. Yea, at thy birth, when thou hadst sat in glory, thou, Agni, wast the aim of invocations.
paragraphs.original: अधा ह्यग्ने मह्ना निषद्या सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूथ ।
paragraphs.translit: adhā hyagne mahnā niṣadyā sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūtha |

paragraphs.text: The Gods came near, obedient to thy summons, and thus attained their rank as chief Protectors.
paragraphs.original: तं ते देवासो अनु केतमायन्नधावर्धन्त प्रथमास ऊमाः
paragraphs.translit: taṃ te devāso anu ketamāyannadhāvardhanta prathamāsa ūmāḥ
